title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E8 — Trainee
A former Vietnam medic volunteers to train as a paramedic, but his quick diagnoses and independent medical efforts yield disaster.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E9 — Women!
An outspoken, feminist journalist covering the paramedics manages to alienate both the fire department and Rampart Emergency staff.

title: Emergency!
description:
S2 E10 — Dinner Date
DeSoto maneuvers Gage into a blind date with his wife's cousin; Brackett must operate on a newlywed husband felled by gunshot wounds.

title: The A-Team
description:
S1 E4 — A Small and Deadly War
The team investigates when a SWAT officer suspects his squad of crimes; guests Jack Ging, Dean Stockwell.

title: The A-Team
description:
S1 E5 — Black Day at Bad Rock
The A-Team helps a small-town sheriff fend off a vengeful motorcycle gang. With George Peppard, Dirk Benedict, Mr. T, Dwight Schultz.

title: The A-Team
description:
S1 E6 — The Rabbit Who Ate Las Vegas
The kidnapping of a gambler leads to a mobster (Charles Cioffi) and then to a $100,000 price on Hannibal's head.

title: The A-Team
description:
S1 E7 — The Out-of-Towners
The team aids Manhattan shopkeepers victimized by mobsters extorting protection money; guest Yaphet Kotto.

title: The A-Team
description:
S1 E8 — Holiday in the Hills
Fanatical mountain men attack after the team crash-lands deep in the Appalachians; guests Edward Winter, Bill McKinney.

title: The A-Team
description:
S1 E9 — West Coast Turnaround
A rancher (Stuart Whitman) tries to ruin a Vietnam veteran's (Robert Sampson) struggling farm; guest Tim Rossovich.

title: The A-Team
description:
S1 E10 — One More Time
Guerrilla terrorists capture an Army general and his daughter. With George Peppard, Dirk Benedict, Mr. T, Dwight Schultz.

title: The A-Team
description:
S1 E11 — Till Death Do Us Part
The team rescues Amy's college chum from being forced to marry a tycoon who may have killed her father.

title: The A-Team
description:
S1 E12 — The Beast From the Belly of a Boeing
Hannibal poses as an airline executive to get aboard a jumbo jet hijacked by terrorists; guest Andy Robinson.
